data.content_ref: inline:Replace Boolean attack with a bounded semiring of defense potentials: each edge has a weight in a finite idempotent semiring, and acceptance is the least fixed point of an operator that accumulates the potential of all successful defense paths from committed roots. The semiring is chosen so the operator is monotone and polynomial; reinstatement is computed as a path potential rather than an emergent label. Criticizable because this changes the meaning of attack from defeat to cost, and may fail to preserve the grounded extension as a special case unless the identity element is chosen carefully.
